$comment: Canonical machine-readable vocabulary SoT for Kawa (issue #34). Docs and (future) DB CHECK constraints derive from here; the drift linter enforces consistency. Event types and relations mirror specification-v0.4 §6; public concepts §4. Lineage relations are from PR #28 (subject-identity) and are included forward-looking.
$comment_c1: C1 (event-token drift) scans only the authoritative event-catalog docs. Elsewhere, family.member tokens are overwhelmingly field references (plan.objective, review.verdict) or capability names, not Domain events, so a repo-wide scan would false-positive. Cross-doc event-name consistency beyond the catalog is a v0.2 concern.
$comment_core_docs: The pure semantic-vocabulary docs where NO mechanism name may appear. specification-v0.4 is deliberately excluded: as the consolidated doc it legitimately names replaceable mechanics when stating the stable/replaceable split (§7, §14). emit-enforcement is excluded because it carries an explicit, labelled §7 PostgreSQL reference profile by design.
$comment_mechanism: mechanism_terms must NOT appear in core_semantic_docs (the standards/provider quarantine promised in #24/#26/#30). They are legitimate in profile/physical/mechanics docs (postgresql-physical-schema, security-plane-profile, event-log-and-replication, memory-broker-*) and in the consolidated specification's replaceable-mechanics sections.
